summary: Tuberville signed a 2023 bill redirecting $100 million in Palestinian aid to Israel's Iron Dome, stating Gaza aid 'will ultimately wind up in the hands of Hamas,' and opposed U.S. aid to Gaza, which he framed as 'Hamas-controlled.' He co-signed a 2024 Senate statement calling for Hamas's elimination and, in a 2025 interview, urged restoring the Abraham Accords while saying the conflict cannot be solved by one ceasefire.
